name: Open Design
description: Turns a local coding agent into a design engine that produces prototypes, decks, dashboards, and images, with a desktop app, od CLI, and stdio MCP server.

skills.name: Prototype Generation
skills.description: Generates web, desktop, and mobile prototypes from a brief by composing a skill or design template with your DESIGN.md.

skills.name: Slide Decks
skills.description: Builds magazine-style decks, weekly updates, and pitch decks as project files previewed in the OpenDesign studio.

skills.name: MCP Project Access
skills.description: Installs a stdio MCP server into 16+ agent CLIs with od mcp install so they read tokens, components, and HTML from projects.

skills.name: Plugin Management
skills.description: Lists, searches, installs, applies, and scaffolds OpenDesign plugins from the od CLI or the web UI.
